title: Sordland/Turn06/SnO_ConscriptionAndMilitaryPolicy
description: Conscription law discussion and military policy spending if applicable.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Welcome to the Ministry of Defense..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Welcome to the Ministry of Defense, Mr. President. Let's go to my office.“

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At the entrance, I was greeted by I..."
entries.dialogueText: At the entrance, I was greeted by Iosef and his military entourage of young officers.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”You are overstepping and interrupt..."
entries.dialogueText: ”You are overstepping and interrupting a personal meeting between me and the President.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Valken has a point. The military n..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Valken has a point. The military needs to be on the same page on any changes.“
entries.menuText: ”Valken has a point. The military needs to be on the same page on any changes.“

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef checked his folder before loo..."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef checked his folder before looking at me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A strong knock on the door was hear..."
entries.dialogueText: A strong knock on the door was heard and the Chief of the Armed Forces; Valken Kruger walked in quickly with a frown.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We walked from corridor to corridor..."
entries.dialogueText: We walked from corridor to corridor to reach the office. On the way, we were met with high ranking officers as well as privates. Every time one of these soldiers saw me, they stopped and saluted me.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”This must be something serious. Es..."
entries.dialogueText: ”This must be something serious. Especially since you invited me here.“
entries.menuText: ”This must be something serious. Especially since you invited me here.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Where is Valken? He usually partak..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Where is Valken? He usually partakes in all military meetings.“
entries.menuText: ”Where is Valken? He usually partakes in all military meetings.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Valken is busy at the moment overs..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Valken is busy at the moment overseeing the defensive strategies against Rumburg.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”It is important that you don't get..."
entries.dialogueText: ”It is important that you don't get misinformed on this matter. Valken has another agenda.“

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When we finally arrived at Iosef's..."
entries.dialogueText: When we finally arrived at Iosef's office, his entourage saluted us and left. He closed the door and took a seat.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”The situation with Rumburg is gett..."
entries.dialogueText: ”The situation with Rumburg is getting worse and our lack of funding in the military means that we would fight for survival in a war scenario.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”The situation with Rumburg is gett..."
entries.dialogueText: ”The situation with Rumburg is getting worse and if it wasn't for our investments in the military, I would be even more concerned.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”We are prepared for the worst aren..."
entries.dialogueText: ”We are prepared for the worst aren't we, Iosef?“
entries.menuText: ”We are prepared for the worst aren't we, Iosef?“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Your tone doesn't inspire confiden..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Your tone doesn't inspire confidence in our defensive capabilities.“
entries.menuText: ”Your tone doesn't inspire confidence in our defensive capabilities.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Our soldiers are surely better mot..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Our soldiers are surely better motivated than theirs. We will defend our country!“
entries.menuText: ”Our soldiers are surely better motivated than theirs. We will defend our country!“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”What are our options in improving..."
entries.dialogueText: ”What are our options in improving the situation?“
entries.menuText: ”What are our options in improving the situation?“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Truthfully not fully prepared. We..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Truthfully not fully prepared. We are still going through a few changes in the military to be able to confront them if such day was to arrive.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Our projected capability in the fu..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Our projected capability in the future should restore your confidence but we need to pass several changes to achieve a better situation.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Our efforts to restructure the mil..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Our efforts to restructure the military should prove beneficial in a potential conflict.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Since we refrained from modernisin..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Since we refrained from modernising our military, the traditional force structure would have to match the enemies numbers.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”We would never be able to match th..."
entries.dialogueText: ”We would never be able to match the force of Rumburg on equal terms therefore our switch of the military to a smaller, well-equipped and autonomously led combat units will prove better in the field.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”You have been doing a fantastic jo..."
entries.dialogueText: ”You have been doing a fantastic job, Iosef. The military is in good hands.“
entries.menuText: ”You have been doing a fantastic job, Iosef. The military is in good hands.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”I trust that you will defend the c..."
entries.dialogueText: ”I trust that you will defend the country if it comes to the worst.“
entries.menuText: ”I trust that you will defend the country if it comes to the worst.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Rumburg has superior numbers which..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Rumburg has superior numbers which we can't ever hope to match. The terrain is in our favour but once we cram hundreds of thousands in the mountains logistics will collapse.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”The mandatory conscription law has..."
entries.dialogueText: ”The mandatory conscription law has become a matter of discussion and we need to strike a decision whether to keep it or remove it.“

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef cleared his throat."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef cleared his throat.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Whatever is necessary for our surv..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Whatever is necessary for our survival will be done when the time comes.“
entries.menuText: ”Whatever is necessary for our survival will be done when the time comes.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Isn't Valken the supporter of the..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Isn't Valken the supporter of the quantity over quality approach?“
entries.menuText: ”Isn't Valken the supporter of the quantity over quality approach?“

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "”Why haven't I been invited? What i..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Why haven't I been invited? What is going on here?“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”There is no question in the motiva..."
entries.dialogueText: ”There is no question in the motivation of our armed forces. However we must rely on the reality of the situation, especially when it is a matter of national survival.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”We are making all the necessary pr..."
entries.dialogueText: ”We are making all the necessary preparations but any substantial military support from other nations would be a welcome deterrent against Rumburg.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Throwing bodies at a problem never..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Throwing bodies at a problem never solved it. Not sure if this is the right approach.“
entries.menuText: ”Throwing bodies at a problem never solved it. Not sure if this is the right approach.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”This doctrine worked for decades s..."
entries.dialogueText: ”This doctrine worked for decades so far, no reason to change it. I think the generals have a point.“
entries.menuText: ”This doctrine worked for decades so far, no reason to change it. I think the generals have a point.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”I am doing my best to defend the c..."
entries.dialogueText: ”I am doing my best to defend the country. There is nothing I care for more than Sordland.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Let's hope it doesn't come to that..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Let's hope it doesn't come to that.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”We have never failed to defend thi..."
entries.dialogueText: ”We have never failed to defend this nation from invaders. We won't start now.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”With no disrespect to him but he t..."
entries.dialogueText: ”With no disrespect to him but he thinks that you can outgun the enemy but when fighting a larger force outsmarting them is what matters.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”It is the last step remaining to s..."
entries.dialogueText: ”It is the last step remaining to switch to a modern professional armed force.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Remove mandatory conscription. It..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Remove mandatory conscription. It is time to have a professional force of willingly enlisted soldiers.“
entries.menuText: ”Remove mandatory conscription. It is time to have a professional force of willingly enlisted soldiers.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Are reservists really that damagin..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Are reservists really that damaging to the professional armed forces?“
entries.menuText: ”Are reservists really that damaging to the professional armed forces?“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”If they are a hindrance then we sh..."
entries.dialogueText: ”If they are a hindrance then we should remove mandatory conscription.“
entries.menuText: ”If they are a hindrance then we should remove mandatory conscription.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”It will be a bloodbath for both si..."
entries.dialogueText: ”It will be a bloodbath for both sides.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Keep mandatory conscription. We ne..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Keep mandatory conscription. We need every single able body to defend the nation.“
entries.menuText: ”Keep mandatory conscription. We need every single able body to defend the nation.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Sure. The new changes will be impl..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Sure. The new changes will be implemented as you wish.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Mr. President, I thought I explain..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Mr. President, I thought I explained it. Please rethink-.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”We need all of our resources conce..."
entries.dialogueText: ”We need all of our resources concentrated on our efficient units that will outperform the enemy in our mountainous terrain.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”To truly modernise our fighting fo..."
entries.dialogueText: ”To truly modernise our fighting force we need to rid ourselves of the sluggish and inefficient cadets thrown to the ranks.“

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "”Well we can't have less troops on..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Well we can't have less troops on the front-line than the enemy. Not with our current structure focused on mass mobilisation.“

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "”I agree any huge structural change..."
entries.dialogueText: ”I agree any huge structural change would be too late and too little now.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”The choice is up to you.“"
entries.dialogueText: ”The choice is up to you.“

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "”I mean no disrespect but I am lead..."
entries.dialogueText: ”I mean no disrespect but I am leading the ground operations and I must be informed of any strategic changes.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Well. Now that you are here, what..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Well. Now that you are here, what is your opinion on conscription?“
entries.menuText: ”Well. Now that you are here, what is your opinion on conscription?“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Our restructuring is hindered by a..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Our restructuring is hindered by a hundred thousands of cadets extending our logistics, slowing command structure and reducing the combat efficiency of our experienced units.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”The Minister of Defense is your su..."
entries.dialogueText: ”The Minister of Defense is your superior and so am I.“
entries.menuText: ”The Minister of Defense is your superior and so am I.“

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "”Thank you, Mr. President. We are t..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Thank you, Mr. President. We are talking about our national defense which must be consulted among all staff.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”To clarify, we would have brought..."
entries.dialogueText: ”To clarify, we would have brought the subject up with the General Staff and you.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”It depends if this is the Presiden..."
entries.dialogueText: ”It depends if this is the President's wish.“

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Valken left with a hard salute."
entries.dialogueText: Valken left with a hard salute.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Please excuse us, General Kruger.“"
entries.dialogueText: ”Please excuse us, General Kruger.“
entries.menuText: ”Please excuse us, General Kruger.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Expand the Air Force. We need more..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Expand the Air Force. We need more planes for air superiority.“
entries.menuText: ”Expand the Air Force. We need more planes for air superiority.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Expand the Army. We need more sold..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Expand the Army. We need more soldiers to defend our nation.“
entries.menuText: ”Expand the Army. We need more soldiers to defend our nation.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Expand the Navy. We need to increa..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Expand the Navy. We need to increase the amount of our ships.“
entries.menuText: ”Expand the Navy. We need to increase the amount of our ships.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Modernise the Navy. We need a high..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Modernise the Navy. We need a higher-tech navy.“
entries.menuText: ”Modernise the Navy. We need a higher-tech navy.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Modernise the Army. We need better..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Modernise the Army. We need better equipped soldiers.“
entries.menuText: ”Modernise the Army. We need better equipped soldiers.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Modernise the Air Force. We need a..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Modernise the Air Force. We need a better air force.“
entries.menuText: ”Modernise the Air Force. We need a better air force.“

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "”I could take my leave.“"
entries.dialogueText: ”I could take my leave.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Agreed. There is a place for reser..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Agreed. There is a place for reservists.“
entries.menuText: ”Agreed. There is a place for reservists.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”We don't share the same opinion. T..."
entries.dialogueText: ”We don't share the same opinion. This is a modern age and requires a modern army.“
entries.menuText: ”We don't share the same opinion. This is a modern age and requires a modern army.“

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "”The matter is rather simple from m..."
entries.dialogueText: ”The matter is rather simple from my point of view.“

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "”Our forces have undergone large st..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Our forces have undergone large structural changes changing the operational capabilities and tactics.“

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "”We kept to our traditional army do..."
entries.dialogueText: ”We kept to our traditional army doctrine. It is not devoid of disadvantages.“

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I left the Ministry of Defense and..."
entries.dialogueText: I left the Ministry of Defense and returned to the Maroon Palace.

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "”However, at the end of the day Rum..."
entries.dialogueText: ”However, at the end of the day Rumburg has a larger army, air-force and navy. Our conscripts will fill the much needed weaknesses we have.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”We also have to decide how exactly..."
entries.dialogueText: ”We also have to decide how exactly we spend our additional remaining funds in the military.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Let me look over my documents to s..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Let me look over my documents to see if there is anything else of concern.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Alright. Then we can move on.“"
entries.dialogueText: ”Alright. Then we can move on.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”That settles it then.“"
entries.dialogueText: ”That settles it then.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Mr. President. But-.“"
entries.dialogueText: ”Mr. President. But-.“

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "”I would ask you to consider.“"
entries.dialogueText: ”I would ask you to consider.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”I don't think it is wise to change..."
entries.dialogueText: ”I don't think it is wise to change course now.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Mr. President, we need to prioriti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, we need to prioritize quality over quantity."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Revert the removal of mandatory co..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Revert the removal of mandatory conscription. That is my final decision.“
entries.menuText: ”Revert the removal of mandatory conscription. That is my final decision.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”No. I am content with the decision..."
entries.dialogueText: ”No. I am content with the decision.“
entries.menuText: ”No. I am content with the decision.“

entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”In June we decided to upgrade the..."
entries.dialogueText: ”In June we decided to upgrade the equipment of our military.“

entries.dialogueText: ”The military thanks the administration for the extensive support.“

entries.dialogueText: ”Thank you for listening.“

entries.dialogueText: ”That's about it. I won't take more of your time sir.“

entries.title: Narrator: "I never liked this building. It alw..."
entries.dialogueText: I never liked this building. It always made me feel like I was standing under the concrete foot of a giant getting ready to crush me. It made me feel small and I never quite got used to the feeling even after this many years.

entries.title: Player: "”Let's begin. What is the matter?“"
entries.dialogueText: ”Let's begin. What is the matter?“
entries.menuText: ”Let's begin. What is the matter?“

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He leaned back and interlocked his..."
entries.dialogueText: He leaned back and interlocked his hands.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”I will make sure it won't come to..."
entries.dialogueText: ”I will make sure it won't come to that.“
entries.menuText: ”I will make sure it won't come to that.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Not everything might be up to us,..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Not everything might be up to us, sir.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Not everything might be up to us,..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Not everything might be up to us, sir.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”I will make sure it won't come to..."
entries.dialogueText: ”I will make sure it won't come to that.“
entries.menuText: ”I will make sure it won't come to that.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”The recent military partnership we..."
entries.dialogueText: ”The recent military partnership we have signed with Agnolia includes a mutual-defense clause.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”In case of conflict we will be obl..."
entries.dialogueText: ”In case of conflict we will be obliged to come to each others aid. In case of a Rumburg invasion, they will come for help.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Do you think their support would b..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Do you think their support would be enough to hold the line?“
entries.menuText: ”Do you think their support would be enough to hold the line?“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”I don't think so.“"
entries.dialogueText: ”I don't think so.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”These are challenging times for us..."
entries.dialogueText: ”These are challenging times for us. Rumburg is a vulture circling around the region.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”It is a disgrace that we have to r..."
entries.dialogueText: ”It is a disgrace that we have to rely on other nations for our defense.“
entries.menuText: ”It is a disgrace that we have to rely on other nations for our defense.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Mr. President, we need stronger al..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Mr. President, we need stronger allies.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Sure, Agnolia is better than nothi..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Sure, Agnolia is better than nothing but we must look further. Lespia or Valgsland are options in my opinion.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Any deterrence should force them t..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Any deterrence should force them to think twice.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Do you really think that is absolu..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Do you really think that is absolutely necessary?“
entries.menuText: ”Do you really think that is absolutely necessary?“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Advice noted. I will bring it up t..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Advice noted. I will bring it up to Deivid.“
entries.menuText: ”Advice noted. I will bring it up to Deivid.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Yes, it is. The danger far outweig..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Yes, it is. The danger far outweighs the sacrifice.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Sordland stands alone as always, I..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Sordland stands alone as always, Iosef. We won't rely on help from anyone else.“
entries.menuText: ”Sordland stands alone as always, Iosef. We won't rely on help from anyone else.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”I think the same way however, I am..."
entries.dialogueText: ”I think the same way however, I am tasked with our nations defense. We need to look at the situation realistically.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”I'd rather prevent a war altogethe..."
entries.dialogueText: ”I'd rather prevent a war altogether.“
entries.menuText: ”I'd rather prevent a war altogether.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Me too but we might not have a cho..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Me too but we might not have a choice.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”I'd rather prevent a war altogethe..."
entries.dialogueText: ”I'd rather prevent a war altogether.“
entries.menuText: ”I'd rather prevent a war altogether.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Me too but we might not have a cho..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Me too but we might not have a choice.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Let's wait for Valken before we ma..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Let's wait for Valken before we make a decision. I wanna hear his viewpoint.“
entries.menuText: ”Let's wait for Valken before we make a decision. I wanna hear his viewpoint.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Mr. President, I don't think that..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Mr. President, I don't think that will be necessary. He won't be comi-“

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I thought for a moment before makin..."
entries.dialogueText: I thought for a moment before making my decision.

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "”What is the meaning of this?! Iose..."
entries.dialogueText: ”What is the meaning of this?! Iosef?“

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Valken deliberated the situation."
entries.dialogueText: Valken deliberated the situation.

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "”I see what is going on here.“"
entries.dialogueText: ”I see what is going on here.“

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "”Disappointing. So this is how the..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Disappointing. So this is how the administration conducts matters on military affairs.“

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Valken looked furiously in my eyes."
entries.dialogueText: Valken looked furiously in my eyes.

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: "”You heard your superior, Iosef.“"
entries.dialogueText: ”You heard your superior, Iosef.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”As you wish, Mr. President.“"
entries.dialogueText: ”As you wish, Mr. President.“

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef threw an angry look at Valken..."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef threw an angry look at Valken before turning to me.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I saluted and Iosef saluted back."
entries.dialogueText: I saluted and Iosef saluted back.
entries.menuText: Salute.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I saluted. Valken and Iosef saluted..."
entries.dialogueText: I saluted. Valken and Iosef saluted back.
entries.menuText: Salute.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Have a good day.“"
entries.dialogueText: ”Have a good day.“
entries.menuText: ”Have a good day.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Thank you for your time.“"
entries.dialogueText: ”Thank you for your time.“
entries.menuText: ”Thank you for your time.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”The Kruger fortification line in c..."
entries.dialogueText: ”The Kruger fortification line in construction should help us in the defense of the mountainous and hilly provinces and at the worst case delay a potential advance.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”As a result of the recent deal wit..."
entries.dialogueText: ”As a result of the recent deal with Wehlen, we have started reinforcing the border.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Forward scouts have been deployed..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Forward scouts have been deployed and we have started moving our divisions.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Rest assured. We are ready for any..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Rest assured. We are ready for anything that will come from the other side of the border.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”We will be providing our reports t..."
entries.dialogueText: ”We will be providing our reports to you.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”I don't think we will have any pro..."
entries.dialogueText: ”I don't think we will have any problems but stay alert. We don't know what we are dealing with yet.“
entries.menuText: ”I don't think we will have any problems but stay alert. We don't know what we are dealing with yet.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”I don't want anyone in. Do not let..."
entries.dialogueText: ”I don't want anyone in. Do not let a single deserter pass our borders.“
entries.menuText: ”I don't want anyone in. Do not let a single deserter pass our borders.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Try to be lenient if possible. The..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Try to be lenient if possible. There might be people who are simply trying to escape war among them.“
entries.menuText: ”Try to be lenient if possible. There might be people who are simply trying to escape war among them.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”We are always ready for any situat..."
entries.dialogueText: ”We are always ready for any situation, Mr. President.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”We won't, Mr. President.“"
entries.dialogueText: ”We won't, Mr. President.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”We will try, Mr. President.“"
entries.dialogueText: ”We will try, Mr. President.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”As a result of the recent deal wit..."
entries.dialogueText: ”As a result of the recent deal with Wehlen, we have started organising the troops for the joint operation.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”General Valken and I were discussi..."
entries.dialogueText: ”General Valken and I were discussing the war plan.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”12th battalion of the 3rd Army, al..."
entries.dialogueText: ”12th battalion of the 3rd Army, along with air support units, will do the job.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”We will meet up with the Wehzek mi..."
entries.dialogueText: ”We will meet up with the Wehzek military command to discuss our joint strategy.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Excellent. I will be waiting for t..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Excellent. I will be waiting for the results.“
entries.menuText: ”Excellent. I will be waiting for the results.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Show them the might of the Sordish..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Show them the might of the Sordish Armed Forces.“
entries.menuText: ”Show them the might of the Sordish Armed Forces.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Be wary. I don't trust Wiktor Smol..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Be wary. I don't trust Wiktor Smolak even a little bit, nor his army.“
entries.menuText: ”Be wary. I don't trust Wiktor Smolak even a little bit, nor his army.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”You will be provided with our repo..."
entries.dialogueText: ”You will be provided with our reports.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”We are always ready for any situat..."
entries.dialogueText: ”We are always ready for any situation, Mr. President.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”The entire world will see, Mr. Pre..."
entries.dialogueText: ”The entire world will see, Mr. President. Don't doubt it.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”Let's move on to our main topic.“"
entries.dialogueText: ”Let's move on to our main topic.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Remove mandatory conscription. It..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Remove mandatory conscription. It is time to have a professional force of willingly enlisted soldiers.“
entries.menuText: ”Remove mandatory conscription. It is time to have a professional force of willingly enlisted soldiers.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Keep mandatory conscription. We ne..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Keep mandatory conscription. We need every single able body to defend the nation.“
entries.menuText: ”Keep mandatory conscription. We need every single able body to defend the nation.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”The facts are that the conscriptio..."
entries.dialogueText: ”The facts are that the conscription gives us a large reservist pool that can cover a larger frontline but these troops lack the morale and quality to be offensive elements.“

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "”My argument would be to remove con..."
entries.dialogueText: ”My argument would be to remove conscription if our military can stand on it's own two feet without them. If we are going to have strong allies why do we need conscripts?“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”You can stay, Valken.“"
entries.dialogueText: ”You can stay, Valken.“
entries.menuText: ”You can stay, Valken.“

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""Your final decision, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your final decision, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Please leave us to conduct the mee..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Please leave us to conduct the meeting in private, Valken.“
entries.menuText: ”Please leave us to conduct the meeting in private, Valken.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "”Tell me what you think, General Kr..."
entries.dialogueText: ”Tell me what you think, General Kruger.“
entries.menuText: ”Tell me what you think, General Kruger.“
